notes: First public release. Everything below already worked for one machine; this version is about it working on yours.
A session you start from the phone now opens by telling you where the work stands, instead of sitting silent until you type something.
Sessions you started at the desk are found whichever Claude profile you use, not just the default one.
Setup no longer asks you to install anything the app does not use. The guide is five steps, and it explains why the order matters.
Tap a project on your phone to start a Claude Code session on the PC - the same live session you get at the desk.
Tap STOP to end a session. Ask Claude for a summary first if you want one - the app does not write anything on your behalf.
Sessions you started at the desk show up in the list too, marked "desktop", and can be ended from the phone.
A folder that only holds other projects shows as one row you can open, so a deep projects folder stays a short list.
One passcode, set once at the desk, guards everything. Unlocking lasts 12 hours, and repeated wrong guesses lock the app out for a while.
If the PC is still waking up, the app says so and fills itself in as soon as the agent answers, instead of hanging or failing.
A slow launch on a cold PC can no longer start the same project twice.
Add it to your home screen - the app shell loads offline, and it is reachable only over your own Tailscale network.
